Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)]]: C-3PO and R2-D2 in a corridor of Princess Leia's ship, the ''Tantive IV'', as Imperial troops board it at the start of ''Star Wars''. Soon after, in the same sequence, Threepio tells Artoo: "Don't call me a mindless philosopher, you overweight glob of grease!"

Source: [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/File:Noescapefortheprincessthistime.png Noescapefortheprincessthistime.png], Wookieepedia (a frame from ''Star Wars'' (1977); 1918 by 816 pixels).
